title: VPN keeps disconnecting
body: Make sure you are on the latest VPN client version (Help > Check for updates). Switch from wifi to a wired connection if possible, and disable any other VPN or proxy apps. If it still drops more than once an hour, file a ticket and include roughly when it drops.

title: Reset your password or unlock your account
body: Use the self-service portal (Forgot password on the sign-in page). Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts and unlock on their own. If you no longer have access to your registered phone or recovery email, file a ticket so an agent can verify you.

title: Printer shows offline
body: Check the printer's display for paper jams or empty trays, then power-cycle it. On your laptop, remove the printer and add it again from the print server list. If several people on the same floor see it offline, file one ticket for the floor.

title: Laptop running slowly
body: Restart (not just sleep) and let pending updates finish. Close browser tabs and apps you are not using, and check Task Manager or Activity Monitor for anything using high CPU. If it is a brand-new laptop or the slowness started right after an update, file a ticket.

title: Email not syncing on your phone
body: Remove and re-add the work account in the Outlook mobile app, and make sure the phone has a stable connection. Check that the app has background refresh allowed. If webmail shows new mail but the phone does not after re-adding, file a ticket.

title: Requesting a software license
body: Software licenses (Adobe, Photoshop, Visio and similar) need your manager's approval. File a ticket in the Software category with the software name, who needs it and a short business reason.

title: Accessing the shared drive from home
body: Shared drives are only reachable while connected to the VPN. Connect to the VPN first, then reconnect the mapped drive. If the VPN is connected and the drive still is not reachable, file a ticket.

title: Screen mirroring in meeting rooms
body: Use the HDMI or USB-C cable at the table first. For wireless mirroring, your laptop must be on the office wifi, not the guest network. Press Windows+K (or the AirPlay icon on a Mac) and choose the room name shown on the screen.

title: Wifi dropping in the office
body: Forget the office network and reconnect, and make sure you are on the staff network rather than guest. If several people in the same area lose wifi at once, it is likely an access point problem, so file one ticket with the location.

title: Equipment for a new starter
body: New starter equipment (laptop, monitor, accounts) should be requested at least 5 working days before their start date. File a ticket in the Hardware category with their name, start date and role.
